name: Calendarific
tagline: Holiday and observance data for 200+ countries worldwide
description: Calendarific is a holiday API providing national, local, religious, and optional observances for 200+ countries. Developers use it to look up holidays by country, year, and type, with support for multi-language names and regional variations for calendar, scheduling, and localization apps.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter; free self-serve signup at calendarific.com

pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans from ~$9.99/mo with higher monthly request quotas; see pricing page

rate_limits: Tied to plan monthly request quotas; finer per-second limits not clearly published
use_cases: list public holidays for a country and year
check if a given date is a holiday in a country
get religious and optional observances for localization
filter holidays by type (national, religious, observance)
